items.title: Enterprise Analytics Platform
items.tagline: High-throughput telemetry and business intelligence dashboard.
items.summary: Full-stack analytics suite processing millions of events with real-time Spring Boot streaming.

techStack.reason: Cloud deployment on EC2 and RDS

overview: Architecture and design of an enterprise-grade analytics dashboard servicing distributed telemetry.
Implemented asynchronous messaging queues to decouple ingest from analytical queries, ensuring fast rendering even under heavy ingestion.
purpose: Enable real-time visibility into mission-critical business metrics with sub-second dashboard refresh rates.
features: Customizable KPI widget builder with responsive grid layouts
Automated scheduled PDF report generation and email dispatch
challenges: Handling peak ingestion spikes without degrading query latency for concurrent dashboard users.
Resolved by configuring read replicas and Redis in-memory query result caching.
outcome: Reduced dashboard query latencies by 60% and improved reporting speed across all organizational teams.

items.title: Open Source API Toolkit
items.tagline: Developer utilities for clean RESTful Spring Boot services.
items.summary: Lightweight open-source library simplifying response formatting and declarative validation.

overview: Open-source utility created to eliminate boilerplate response formatting and error handling in Spring Boot applications.
Provides opinionated RFC 7807 problem details out of the box with zero third-party dependencies.
purpose: Standardise error envelopes, pagination payloads, and input validation handling across distributed services.
features: Declarative pagination parameters with Spring Data JPA support
Zero external third-party dependencies with tiny binary footprint
challenges: Designing seamless auto-configuration compatible across multiple Spring Boot 3 minor versions.
Solved using conditional annotations and custom bean post-processors.
outcome: Adopted across multiple engineering teams, reducing boilerplate code by over 1,500 lines.

items.title: Cloud Inventory & Logistics Service
items.tagline: High-concurrency warehouse inventory tracking with real-time sync.
items.summary: Distributed inventory management microservice built with Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Docker.

techStack.reason: Type-safe domain modeling and API schemas
ACID transactional guarantees for stock quantities

overview: Engineered a high-concurrency inventory microservice supporting automated barcode scanners and third-party logistics integrations.
Structured relational schemas with optimistic concurrency control to prevent stock overselling during flash promotions.
purpose: Provide real-time inventory counts across three regional fulfillment centers with millisecond response guarantees.
features: Optimistic locking for concurrency-safe stock updates
Automated stock threshold alerts and restock purchase order triggers
Full audit logging of all inventory state mutations
challenges: Resolving race conditions caused by simultaneous mobile barcode scans during peak fulfillment hours.
Solved by implementing row-level database locks and atomic transaction batching.
outcome: Eliminated overselling occurrences to 0% and processed over 250,000 inventory updates daily.

items.title: Cinematic Portfolio Engine
items.tagline: Dark editorial portfolio platform built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS.
items.summary: Modern, content-driven developer portfolio engine designed with custom typography and motion readiness.

techStack.reason: Next.js 16 App Router and static prerendering
Strict end-to-end type safety inferred from Zod schemas
CSS-first Tailwind v4 design token system

overview: Designed and built a cinematic, dark, JSON-driven personal portfolio engine.
Strict separation of concerns where content lives entirely in validated JSON files with presence rules.
purpose: Create a distinctive, non-generic portfolio showcasing full-stack engineering craftsmanship and editorial aesthetics.
features: Zero hard-coded content with 100% Zod schema validation
Dynamic presence rules that automatically prune absent data
Strict design token system with custom four-font typographical hierarchy
challenges: Balancing rich visuals with rigorous accessibility and fast static load times.
Resolved through WCAG AA contrast adherence, keyboard focus traps, and image optimization.
outcome: Achieved 100 Lighthouse performance and accessibility scores with sub-second page loads.
